evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

independent_computation.question: Which ability owns the 6th (index 5) damage event of a Syndra rotation at 120 Splinters of Wrath?
independent_computation.method: Enumerate the damage instances Syndra's kit emits at 120 splinters, in cast order, straight from the cached wiki text in data/champions.json. The scenario's '120' fixes the splinter state, which is what fixes the size of the pre-ultimate event prefix.

step_1_damage_instance_inventory_at_120_.why: Base Q is one magic-damage instance (90/125/160/195/230 + 70% AP). Wiki Q: 'Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.' At 120 splinters the 40-splinter gate is open, so a rotation casts two charges -> 2 damage instances. Corroborated by data/champion-audit/batch-6.json, which lists Syndra's modeled slots as ['P','Q','Q2','W','E','R'] with 'ammo (Q 2nd charge at 40 splinters)' and 'splinters option (0-120) gates Q2 second charge'.

Wiki W recast: 'dealing magic damage to them and nearby enemies once they land' (70/100/130/160/190 + 65% AP) -> one magic instance. Wiki W: 'Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath enhances Force of Will to deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage', carried as its own leveling row ('Bonus True Damage', distinct from 'Total Mixed Damage') -> a second, true-damage instance. At 120 splinters the 60-splinter gate is open.

Wiki E: 'deals magic damage to enemies hit' (60/95/130/165/200 + 60% AP). The sphere-knockback branch explicitly does NOT double-dip: 'dealt Scatter the Weak's damage if they were not damaged by the initial cast'. The 80-splinter Transcendent Bonus is scatter angle + 70% slow only, no added damage.

Wiki P: 'At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence, increasing her ability power by 15%.' A stat buff, not a damage instance (batch-6.json: '120-splinter +15% total AP capstone' listed under buff atoms).

Wiki R: 'Syndra conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones. Afterwards, she barrages the target enemy champion with all collected Dark Spheres, each dealing magic damage upon hit.' The leveling rows arithmetically confirm per-sphere instancing: Minimum 240/360/480 (+60% AP) = 3 x per-sphere 80/120/160 (+20% AP); Maximum 560/840/1120 (+140% AP) = 7 x per-sphere. Wiki note 'Spell shield will only block the damage of a single sphere' confirms the spheres are separate damage instances, not one packet. The 100-splinter execute adds no damage instance (batch-6.json: 'execute (R at 100 splinters - not modeled)').

step_2_prefix_arithmetic.breakdown: Q charge 1 (1) + Q charge 2 [40+ gate] (1) + W magic (1) + W bonus true [60+ gate] (1) + E (1) = 5
step_2_prefix_arithmetic.consequence: For any cast order that finishes on the ultimate - the ordinary case, and the case for every reordering of the three basic abilities - the five basic-ability instances occupy indices 0..4 and R's first sphere lands exactly at index 5.
step_2_prefix_arithmetic.index_5_value_formula: per-sphere magic damage = 80/120/160 (by R rank) + 20% AP, mitigated by 100/(100+MR) (docs/math-foundations.md 2.1)

step_3_why_E_at_index_5_is_not_reachable.argument: E can occupy index 5 only if exactly five damage instances precede it. The instances available to precede E are Q (1), Q2 (1), W magic + W true (2) = 4, plus however many R spheres precede it. 4 + 0 = 4 (E before R) and 4 + N with N >= 3 gives >= 7. The only way to hit exactly 5 is 4 + 1, i.e. an ultimate that contributes a SINGLE damage instance - which contradicts the wiki's per-sphere instancing (min 3 spheres; 'each dealing magic damage upon hit'; spell shield blocks one sphere). Collapsing the barrage into one event would also break the per-event semantics docs/math-foundations.md relies on (shield clipping 'absorbed = min(shield, damage)' and 'Candidate revive authored after every damage event' both price per damage event).
step_3_why_E_at_index_5_is_not_reachable.residual_ways_E_could_legitimately_sit_a: Only exotic orderings that fire the ultimate before E while withholding one or both basic abilities until after it (e.g. W -> R(3 spheres) -> E -> Q -> Q2, or Q -> Q2 -> R(3) -> E -> W). Both require R to grab zero live spheres despite Q spheres being on the ground ('The Dark Sphere then remains on the ground for 6 seconds'; W 'refreshes' a grabbed sphere's duration), so a Q-before-R order should yield N = 3 + (live spheres) = 5, not 3. Under the wiki's own sphere accounting these orderings do not produce E at index 5 either.

independent_computation.conclusion: At 120 Splinters of Wrath the pre-ultimate ledger is exactly five instances long, so damage_events[5] is Unleashed Power's first sphere. 'R' is the wiki-correct source; 'E' requires a one-instance ultimate, which the wiki text contradicts.

module_slots.modeled = [P, Q, Q2, W, E, R] ... splinters option (0-120) gates Q2 second charge, W 60-splinter true-damage (12%+2%/100 AP), P 120-splinter +15% AP buff; R reads 'Magic Damage per Sphere' x user-set sphere count. The one damage.execute atom (R at 100 splinters ...) is explicitly documented as not modeled.

m(R) = 100 / (100 + R) (apply_resistance, resistance.py) ... | Revive (survival walk) | ... Candidate revive authored after every damage event ... | Shield absorption (survival walk) | clipping identity absorbed = min(shield, damage) ...
src/calculator/damage.py computes a rotation from a DEFAULT_CAST_ORDER (fixed Q,W,E,R) ... The event order shown in the UI comes from the fight's cast_order + breakdown damage_events.

caveats: The scenario's own definition (its cast_order and any r_spheres / auto-attack settings) lives outside the permitted evidence tree - it is not present anywhere under data/ or in docs/math-foundations.md - so the cast order could not be read, only reasoned about.
The derivation is order-robust for every cast order that ends on the ultimate (R last): under all of those, at 120 splinters index 5 is R's first sphere and E cannot reach index 5.

The verdict would only flip if the scenario interleaves basic attacks into the same damage_events stream, or fires R before at least one basic ability AND models the barrage as fewer spheres than the wiki's 3-conjured floor plus live Q spheres. Both are ruled out by the wiki text as read here; neither could be confirmed or denied from the permitted tree.
'E' at index 5 is reachable only with a single-instance ultimate, which contradicts 'each dealing magic damage upon hit', the 3x/7x arithmetic of the Minimum/Maximum rows, and the spell-shield note.
